text: 企查查APP显示，近日，深圳市欣发投资有限公司成立，法定代表人为刘成，注册资本为7.5亿元，经营范围包含：新兴能源技术研发；住房租赁；非居住房地产租赁；园区管理服务；以自有资金从事投资活动等。企查查股权穿透显示，该公司由深圳市建瑞投资有限公司、欣旺达动力科技股份有限公司共同持股。（人民财讯）
text_en: Qichacha APP shows that Shenzhen Xinyao Investment Co., Ltd. was recently established, with Liu Cheng as legal representative, registered capital of 750 million yuan, and business scope including: emerging energy technology R&D; housing leasing; non-residential real estate leasing; park management services; investment activities with self-owned funds, etc. Qichacha equity penetration shows the company is jointly held by Shenzhen Jianrui Investment Co., Ltd. and Sunwoda Power Technology Co., Ltd. (People's Financial News)
